title: Murata considers bigger MLCC expansion as AI server demand extends beyond 2028

title: AI servers are eating MLCC capacity, and Chinese suppliers are taking what's left
content: AI servers are reshaping the global multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) market. Murata Manufacturing and Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEMCO) are steering limited capacity toward high-value server components, tightening conventional supply, lifting prices, and creating an opening for Chinese suppliers in PCs.
